title: Commission disburses €4.36 billion to Ukraine under the €90 billion Ukraine Support Loan
content: European Commission Press release Brussels, 05 Nov 2026 Today, the European Commission disbursed €4.36 billion to Ukraine under the Ukraine Support Loan. This payment includes €3.7 billion for the second instalment of macro-financial assistance (MFA) agreed for 2026 and €658 million under the defence leg of the Loan.
